standing: Independent public-source working case. No municipal mandate, partnership, deployment, physical capacity or operational readiness is inferred.

lineage.title: Food-web economics
lineage.role: Federate purchasing, inventory visibility, transport and local supply while independent participants retain ownership. Evaluate full landed cost including paid labor, maintenance, spoilage and coordination.
lineage.standing: Recovered design lineage; economic superiority requires measured operating cases, not a retailer comparison inferred from architecture.

lineage.title: Civil maintenance and distributed-field design
lineage.role: Ordinary maintenance supplies observations, useful work and local skills. The same installed capabilities can support disaster continuity when cloud, vendors, individual nodes or communication links fail.
lineage.standing: Recovered architectural corpus. No field-qualified regional deployment is asserted; sensitive and private source materials are not redistributed.

lineage.title: Manzanita Works
lineage.role: Coordinate tools, time, talent, pilotage, money, mobility, knowledge and space without collapsing their owners or accounting rules. Carry need through evidence, decision owner, safe next step, backup path, outcome and learning.
lineage.standing: Existing public working models and exact owner contracts, not proof of municipal adoption.

lineage.title: AXM Genesis
lineage.role: Retain exact decision records and their causes in signed artifacts that a successor can verify without the originating session. The kernel owns sealing and verification, not whether an institution may act.
lineage.standing: Existing native compiler and verifier; this case uses their unchanged one-pass integration.

lineage.title: Cantos / Second Run
lineage.role: Keep original sources, actual observations, accepted procedures, failed attempts and current dependencies available for repeat work and explicit reconsideration.
lineage.standing: Existing native ResearchCore retained unchanged; bounded civil computations are separate application code.

sources.title: Suginami earthquake response and recovery plan, 2024 revision
sources.claim: The logistics chapter specifies a three-day local food reserve target for approximately 104,000 shelter evacuees, and describes municipal, retailer and transport coordination.
sources.boundary: Printed pages 154–166. Plan targets and named responsibilities are not current stock counts or evidence that all ward residents have weeks of supply.

sources.title: Suginami public evacuation-facility CSV
sources.claim: The retrieved file contains 76 named facility records. The local listing retains names, addresses and source-listed planning capacity.
sources.boundary: The original CSV SHA-256 and extraction are recorded separately. Presence in this listing establishes neither current access nor usable power, stock, staff, communications or shelter readiness.

sources.title: Tokyo Metropolitan Central Wholesale Market: Ota market overview
sources.claim: Ota is a major market handling produce, seafood and flowers; its stated produce and flower roles are distinct from the complete food supply of Tokyo.
sources.boundary: Market statistics cannot be promoted into a sole-food-chokepoint claim. Each participating supplier and alternate route needs an actual custody and delivery record.

sources.title: NICT: license-exempt low-power communications and technical certification
sources.claim: NICT describes 920 MHz low-power telemetry/data equipment as usable without an individual station license when the applicable equipment technical certification is satisfied.
sources.boundary: License exemption does not mean unregulated operation. This page does not select a radio or establish compliance, coverage, channel capacity, interference tolerance or site permission.

sources.title: The Future is Public, Transnational Institute
sources.claim: The publication examines democratic public ownership and reports more than 1,400 remunicipalisation cases involving over 2,400 cities in 58 countries.
sources.boundary: This is evidence of documented cases, not evidence that thousands of cities adopted one person's identical policy or any particular software.
